description: On the tabletop in front of you is a small white cabinet-like box with a hinged front, and a small cube block nearby, while the left hand rests closer to the center. The right hand reaches toward the cabinet, presses and swings the front panel open, then reaches inside and pulls out a small cube block, bringing it forward and setting it down on the table in front of the open cabinet before letting go, while the left hand remains mostly still and not touching any object.
